properties.description: On the real design (every node type, every property shape, every odd id this project has written; about 6,600 nodes and 43,000 edges), in either committed form: import then export gives the committed design's hash (no node, edge or property dropped or invented); written as item files and read back, the nodes and edges are identical and the computed hash equal; imported from the layout into a fresh store it exports identically, and re-exported over its own layout it writes no file; every Artifact checksum the record holds (on the node, or derived from the accepting change's checksum_after) comes back into both stores.
properties.findings: 2026-10-04 (chg:item-layout-lineage-holds-through-a-conflict-resolved-mid-merge-2026-10-04): passes on this branch's single file (6,649 nodes, 43,130 edges, more than 100 artifact checksums restored); 70 s in a debug build on a 4-core box. Run by hand against the converted layout of #673 as well.
properties.name: reflow2's own committed design round-trips through the item layout with nothing lost
